FAQ

What's in the diagnostic report?

User acquisition trends, retention metrics (D7/D30), sybil risk estimate, top growth bottlenecks specific to your project type (Perps / DEX / Lending / etc). Plus 3 concrete recommendations with expected impact.

How long until I get the report?

Within 24 hours of submission. Delivered by email and Telegram DM. For urgent requests, mention it in your Telegram handle field.

Is it really free?

Yes. No payment, no credit card. We do this to find projects that fit TaskOn services well. No obligation if we're not a fit.

How is my data handled?

We only use public on-chain data plus what you share with us. We never share your contact info outside TaskOn. We don't sell data. See our privacy policy for details.

What if my project isn't a Perps DEX?

We diagnose DeFi / Lending / CEX / Quest-based platforms too. Different patterns but same methodology. Mention your project type in your Telegram handle field if it helps.
